en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 11. He said: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn reported to me from his father, who reported from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, who reported from Muhammad ibn Abu Al-Sahban, from Muhammad ibn Abu Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, that: Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad (as) who said: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:
"Blessed is he who denounces the tempting ready desire, to earn the promised blessing he has not seen."
